workloads.num_valid: int — configurations passing all hardware constraints
workloads.num_pareto: int — unique (occupancy, effective_ai) points on Pareto frontier
workloads.pareto_frontier: list[config_result] — one representative per Pareto point, sorted by score descending

structure.overall_best: config_result — config with highest geometric mean score across all workloads, with geo_mean_score field added

config_result.occupancy: float — fraction of max warps active
config_result.effective_ai: float — effective arithmetic intensity (FLOP/byte) with L2 reuse
config_result.smem_bytes: int — shared memory per CTA in bytes
config_result.bottleneck: string — one of: smem, regs, warps, max_blocks

tiebreaker_order: When multiple configs share the same score (or same Pareto point), select the one with: lowest smem_bytes, then lowest num_warps, then lowest BLOCK_SIZE_M, BLOCK_SIZE_N, BLOCK_SIZE_K, GROUP_SIZE_M, num_stages
